guard: Managed run issuance requires independent current child scope and fresh direct-parent run grant, uses exact native signed ceiling and own lifecycle source, preserves interactive issuance and owner-confined manager workflows.

mutations.name: remove child run predicate
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 persona without run receives no issuance
mutations.cell: U1 persona without run receives no issuance

mutations.name: remove direct parent run predicate
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 admin parent without run receives no issuance and stock refusal
mutations.cell: U1 admin parent without run receives no issuance and stock refusal

mutations.name: remove interactive issuance
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 interactive user still starts answers and resumes
mutations.cell: U1 interactive user still starts answers and resumes

mutations.name: restore managed legacy rail
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 eligible managed seat receives issued authority and accepted-row read
mutations.cell: U1 eligible managed seat receives issued authority and accepted-row read

mutations.name: widen signed ceiling after evidence
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 evidence ceiling equals the stock signed mint
mutations.cell: U1 evidence ceiling equals the stock signed mint

mutations.name: replace child source with parent actor
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 source is the managed actor lifecycle and respawn invalidates it
mutations.cell: U1 source is the managed actor lifecycle and respawn invalidates it

mutations.name: renew a changed ceiling
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 same nonce renews only the identical ceiling
mutations.cell: U1 same nonce renews only the identical ceiling

mutations.name: ignore managed source lifecycle
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 source is the managed actor lifecycle and respawn invalidates it
mutations.cell: U1 source is the managed actor lifecycle and respawn invalidates it

mutations.name: deny run seat answers as baseline
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 managed persona run grant can answer and baseline seat cannot answer outside relay
mutations.cell: U1 managed persona run grant can answer and baseline seat cannot answer outside relay

mutations.name: permit baseline answers outside relay
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 managed persona run grant can answer and baseline seat cannot answer outside relay
mutations.cell: U1 managed persona run grant can answer and baseline seat cannot answer outside relay

mutations.name: widen mediator to foreign launch door
mutations.replace:
...epRequestGrantRows(space, { endpoint: BASELINE_LIFECYCLE_ENDPOINT, command: "spawn" }, caller),
    ...epRequestGrantRows(space, { endpoint: BASELINE_LIFECYCLE_ENDPOINT, command: "launch" }, caller),
mutations.expectRed: FAIL: U1 seat-started run spawns only its owner and cross-owner launch is broker refused
mutations.cell: U1 seat-started run spawns only its owner and cross-owner launch is broker refused
